While it marked this as present, the lack of ANY surface detail (seams, panels, rivets) on a rigid airship is physically implausible and indicative of AI smoothing, which should be flagged as a defect rather than just a 'present' feature. The verdicts for visible geometry (cigar shape, symmetry) are accurate.

I agree with the Router that the smoothness is an artifact (AI 'waxiness'), but the lighting inconsistency noted by the Router is subtle. The depth map confirms the airship is spatially distinct from the background, ruling out severe fusion. The primary artifact is the unnatural lack of high-frequency detail on the hull.

The visible checkpoints (silhouette, symmetry, general fin presence) are all met. Points are deducted because the inability to verify critical functional components (gondola, engines) due to resolution/omission prevents a perfect score, and the surface texture lacks the realism expected of the class.

This was correctly flagged by the Router but underestimated by the Perceptual Auditor. The lighting mismatch between the bright airship and the darker foreground building suggests compositing or generation inconsistencies.
